title: Application Behavior & Human Assurance
description: Human verification rules for ASVS requirements that cannot be concluded reliably from unattended CLI evidence.

rules.title: ASVS 2.1.1 Input validation rules are documented

args.review: MANDATORY HUMAN ASSESSMENT: Review the documented formats, limits, allowlists, and validation rules for security-sensitive and business-critical inputs. Magebean CLI cannot determine or attest compliance for this requirement.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.

rules.title: ASVS 2.3.1 Business workflows enforce the required sequence

args.review: MANDATORY HUMAN ASSESSMENT: Review critical business workflows to confirm required steps cannot be skipped, reordered, replayed, or completed for another user. Magebean CLI cannot determine or attest compliance for this requirement.

messages.manual_review: NOT VERIFIED BY MAGEBEAN CLI. Independent human assessment and documented supporting evidence are mandatory before this requirement can be considered satisfied.
